parts.title: Splitting & Folds
parts.description: Seeded train/test splitting and contiguous k-fold cross-validation indices.

parts.title: Classification Metrics
parts.description: Confusion matrix, accuracy, binary precision/recall/F1, and macro-F1.

parts.title: Ranking & Regression Metrics
parts.description: Tie-safe ROC AUC, plus MAE, RMSE, and R^2.

steps.name: train_test_split
steps.doc:
Shuffle (seeded) and split into (X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test); the
test set is round(n * test_frac) rows.

steps.name: k_fold_indices
steps.doc:
Return k (train_idx, test_idx) pairs of contiguous folds over range(n).
The test folds partition all n indices; train is the complement.

steps.name: confusion_matrix
steps.doc: (num_classes, num_classes) integer matrix; rows are true, cols predicted.

steps.name: precision_recall_f1
steps.doc:
Binary precision, recall, F1 for the positive class (label 1), as a tuple.
Each is 0.0 when its denominator is zero.

steps.name: macro_f1
steps.doc: Unweighted mean of per-class F1 from a confusion matrix (rows=true).

steps.name: roc_auc
steps.doc:
Binary ROC AUC via the rank (Mann-Whitney) formula, tie-safe. y in {0,1};
returns 0.5 if a class is absent.

steps.name: r2_score
steps.doc: Coefficient of determination R^2 = 1 - SS_res / SS_tot (a float).
